jobs_results.title: Junior Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Description Media.Monks is looking for an ambitious Junior Project Manager to help coordinate projects for an iconic automotive brand across video, print and digital. We are looking for someone who is keen to become hyper-skilled in managing projects, external agencies, and clients, while learning how to safeguard stellar quality and processes.

Role & Responsibilities• Work as part of our fast-growing team and wear multiple hats to help your local team get projects completed.
• Support the day-to-day tasks of running projects: putting together crystal clear briefings and coordinating teams.
• Liaise with the media agency and gather all relevant specs, deadlines, and requirements.
• Be the glue between client, media, external agencies, local creative teams and central production hubs.
• Where possible, manage client relations and communications. Take meeting minutes, outline action steps and debrief the broader team.
• Responsible for updating scopes and quotes where needed.
• Source... assets from the client’s DAM, log usage rights, and organise project files and documentation for creative and production teams.
• Keep a close eye on quality and make sure all assets delivered to the client fit the original brief.

Requirements• 1-2 years of experience coordinating projects and/or teams. Preferably in production or creative agencies but this is not a must.
• Experience with fast-paced work environments and cross-cultural teams.
• Clear and strong communication skills in English, and your local language.
• Desire to learn fast across several integrated production streams and broaden your experience.
• Team player and self-starter with an unbreakable positive mindset.
• People enjoy working with you and you enjoy coordinating teams.
• Humble, open to feedback, and proactive in seeking ways to develop when time allows.
• Ambitious, gritty and resilient.
• High-quality standards

#LI-NB1

About Media.Monks:

Media.Monks is the purely digital operating brand of S4Capital plc that connects 8,600+ digital natives across one global team. We are united by a mission to shift industries forward and pave the path towards ambitious outcomes so our clients and our people can realize their full potential for growth. Our unified model combines solutions in media, data, social, platforms, studio, experience, brand and technology services to help our clients continuously reinvent themselves throughout increasingly rapid cycles of disruption. Our efforts to shape culture, build innovative technologies and unlock the future of growth have earned recognition from numerous esteemed panels: we maintain a constant presence on Adweek’s Fastest Growing lists (2019-22), regular recognition at Cannes Lions, inclusion in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players (2020-23), the title of Webby Production Company of the Year (2021-23), a record number of FWAs, and have earned a spot on Newsweek’s Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces 2023. Together, these achievements solidify our experience in digital innovation, excellence in craft, and commitment to personal growth.

While we continue to grow our teams, please be mindful of fraudulent job postings and recruiting activities that may use our company name and information. Please be mindful to protect your personal information, especially your national identification number, and bank account information during a recruiting process. While Media.Monks may reach out to potential candidates via LinkedIn, we will always ask applicants to apply through our website (https://media.monks.com/careers) and will never ask for payment or bank account information during the recruitment process.

Disclaimer: • Responsible for resourcing and implementing security controls for your teams processes and systems
• Responsible that all your personnel apply information security in accordance with the established information security policy

jobs_results.title: Project Manager - Adobe CRM (EN)
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

Exciting Opportunity:

No Spanish? No problem! Join Us in Madrid for the International CRM Hub!

We're thrilled to announce an incredible opportunity for our employees to join a special project program in Madrid, Spain. At Publicis Groupe, we believe in fostering growth, exploration, and collaboration, and this initiative embodies those values perfectly.

Project Program Details:
• Duration: 6 weeks, 3 months or permanently (up to you!)
• Start Date: Mid-April (the assignment will be confirmed the week before)
• Deadline for applications: 17th March 2024
• Language: C1 English is a must. Spanish is not required for this opportunity.
• Transition Team: A dedicated team will assist in facilitating the transition while we hire the permanent team. This includes accommodation, transportation, labor advisorship,… (if you choose the 3-month period, you will have a monthly flight back home)
• Permanent Move: For those considering a permanent relocation to Madrid, this is... definitely an option! You can transfer to Publicis Groupe Spain. Daily Paella is not included in the deal.
• Requirements: EU work permit and the ability to move to Madrid on a short notice 😊

Job Description

Overseeing the day-to-day operations and ensuring that the operations runs efficiently and effectively. Coordinate and manage operational activities to achieve the goals and objectives according to markets needs.

What are the responsabilities?

Ensure operation:
• Privileged interlocutor of the IT&Data CRM teams .
• Make sure partner’s SLA are respected
• Process & Quality improvement
• Main contact for Country request not related to campaigns

Qualifications
• Excellent technic knowledge of Adobe Campaign Classic tool is required
• Understanding of business needs
• A datamining sensitivity
• Fluent in English (written & spoken)
• Spanish is not required for this role

Additional Information

Why join us? Because we offer reasons such as:

🌟 Flexible Benefits: Enjoy more than just work with flexible compensation including meal vouchers, health insurance, transportation, and more.

🚀 Growth Opportunities: Advance in your professional career by working with major clients and gaining access to specialized training programs.

📚 Online Training: Through our artificial intelligence platform, access countless courses. Additionally, free English classes for groups of up to 6 people with native teachers.

🌍 Work from Anywhere: Telecommute for 6 weeks from over 100 countries (including Spain) with our #WorkYourWorld program.

🎉 Special Days Off: Celebrate your holidays, birthdays, and Advertising Day with additional days off.

✨ Work-Life Balance: Enjoy a hybrid model with up to two days working from home and intensive summer hours.

Here at Publicis Groupe, we are committed to building a culturally diverse workforce and therefore strongly encourages applications from underrepresented groups. We are committed to equality of opportunity and welcome applications from all individuals, regardless of their background: we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status on any individual´s status in any group or class protected by law.

If you have any reasonable adjustment needs arising from a disability or medical condition to fully participate in the recruitment process, please discuss this with the recruiter who contacts you

jobs_results.title: Sr Project Leader - Barcelona
jobs_results.description:
As an Arcadian, you already help us deliver world leading sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets. You are part of our global business comprising 36,000 people, in over 70 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life.

Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can continue to solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.

Role description:

Arcadis is looking for a Project Manager to join our team in Barcelona, ES.

Our ideal candidate will have experience in Project Management, technical background, and good personal soft skills with innovative and digital orientation. Will be part of our Project Management team reporting to Sr. Project Manager.

The role will be responsible of operationally deliver/manage (sub)projects in line with budgetary, compliance, regulatory and planning controls within required standards of quality, delivery, and safety.

Role... accountabilities:

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
• Deliver monodisciplinary projects or subprojects in multidisciplinary projects (follow up and manage financial targets, highlight deviations and quality assurance)
• Lead the definition (scope) and implementation of projects (plans, technical information and specifics of the project, planning)
• Contribute to cross discipline collaboration
• Oversee junior project staff involved and guide on decision making during the delivery of the project
• Internal and external coordination, maintaining and expanding network and client relationship
• Advise on (sub)project related issues and have a fluent relationship with the project client and the different parts of the project (ex. Suppliers, contractors, etc)
• Represent the culture and brand of Arcadis (ambassadorship) especially applying the Arcadis Way Standard for project management

Qualifications & Experience:
• 7+ years of Project Management experience (Experience in Real Estate projects will be highly appreciate – residential, retail, hospitality, etc).

Preferred Requirements:
• B.S. in Architecture/Building Engineering/Engineering
• PMP certification will be especially appreciated
• English: Advanced (client´s meetings and reporting will be done in English) – be aware that the recruitment process might be conducted in English as well as interviews)

Continue your career journey as an Arcadian.

We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.

You do meaningful work, and no matter where your next role in Arcadis takes you, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark; on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.

Together, we can create a lasting legacy.

Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging

We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day, which is why we take equality and inclusion seriously and hold ourselves to account for our actions. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: Europe

Oasis is a privacy focused L1 blockchain with a highly scalable, cross-chain enabled architecture that is able to provide data sovereignty and on-chain privacy to the whole Web3 ecosystem. The Oasis Protocol Foundation supports projects focused on building privacy-preserving applications on top of the Oasis Network.

Objective:

The primary objective of the Project Manager is to ensure the successful planning, execution, and delivery of projects within the marketing, community and business development domains. This includes managing project timelines, budgets, resources, and risks to meet business objectives and stakeholder expectations.

Key Responsibilities:
• Sort and maintain the task lists for the Community, Marketing and Business Development teams.
• Suggest and implement project management tools to improve task coordination and lead the effort to put processes in place to improve team productivity.
• Monitor project... progress and adjust plans as necessary to ensure adherence to deadlines and quality standards.
• Act as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, providing regular updates on project status, risks, and issues.
• Conduct regular reviews and inspections to identify defects and implement corrective actions.
• Compile lessons learned and best practices for future reference and improvement.
• Allocate resources effectively to ensure project tasks are completed on time and within budget.
• Set up and organize meetings for the Community, Marketing and Business Development teams.
• Sync up with leads of other teams to schedule syncs and discussions when needed.
• Handle external communication with partners and service providers.

Key Person Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience.
• Proven experience as a project manager or similar role in a technology or blockchain company.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work with teams across different departments such as: Marketing, Community and Business Development.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to improve processes and identify areas for improvement.
• Experience in implementing project management tools and processes to improve team productivity.

Interview Process:
• Initial screening call with Recruitment team to discuss qualifications and experience.
• Technical interview with the Director of Operations to discuss project management tools and processes.
• Cross-team collaboration interview with BD and Engineering / Community and Marketing team representatives
• Final interview with the team leads and upper management to assess fit and discuss specific responsibilities and expectations.

This is a great time to join Oasis Foundation.

Location: The role can be based anywhere with flexible and remote work options. Europe time zone is preferred.

Please note: This is a full-time role that will be paid in USDT OR USDC cryptocurrency.

jobs_results.title: Sr. Project Manager / Scrum Master
jobs_results.description:
Our opportunity

As a Sr. Project Manager / Scrum Master, you are responsible for the operational management of distinct mid-size local/regional projects or mid-size projects of a program and ensures that the overall project objectives are clearly defined and met. These projects are characterized by medium complexity, medium change and communications elements and important business impact. Understands and is able to apply different delivery approaches (waterfall, Scrum, ZurichLean) and performs, independently, project management processes to initiate, plan, execute, monitor and control as well as close a project in accordance with the Zurich Project Management Framework and the Zurich Risk Policy.

You will be part of Change Delivery Service team within Investment Solutions (Investment Admin & Accounting function). The team is responsible for the delivery of all changes related to IAA core systems. The team is working in a self-organized dedicated approach and has all the required... roles to deliver a project in the Dedicated Team. The team is empowered to organize their work, to manage project backlog, priority and resources.

Your role

As a Sr. Project Manager / Scrum Master your main responsibilities will involve
• Manages and delivers multiple projects, small & medium sized in the area of Investment Accounting & Administration
• Facilitates and coordinates completion of its agreed deliverables with the project team
• Responsible for the overall quality of project deliverables and removing any impediments to delivery the project on quality, time and budget
• Manages the dependencies internal and external to the project
• Communicates effectively with project stakeholders, customers and leadership team to manage expectation and outcome
• Ensure timely and appropriate planning, collection, creation, distribution, storage, retrieval, management, control, monitoring, and the ultimate disposition of project information to enable effective decision making and ensure successful project outcomes.
• Adheres to the overall Zurich Project Management Framework and PMO’s governance (project charter, project budget and funding, risk/issue management, project plan, change request, status updates, etc)

Your Skills and Experience

As a Sr. Project Manager / Scrum Master, your skills and qualifications will ideally include:
• At least 10-15 years of project management experience, managing large, multi-functions, multi-geography projects in Financial Institution companies
• At least 3-5 years of experience managing scrum / agile projects
• PMP or other project management certification
• Agile / Scrum certification
• Ability to adapt to Zurich preferred project management tool
• Experience in managing distributed project teams in a multi-cultural environment
• Good knowledge of investment instruments and investment accounting processes
• Strong communication and presentation skills and experience in working with C-level
• Fluent English is a must
• Experience in applying different project management methodologies (i.e. waterfalls, scrum, agile etc.

Additional Information

Primary work location is Barcelona. You can apply by clicking on the button “Apply online”

Who we are

 

Looking for a challenging and inspiring work environment where you can make a difference? At Zurich millions of individuals and businesses place their trust in our products and services every day. Our 53,000 employees worldwide form the basis of our success, enabling, businesses and communities to face a world of risk with confidence. Imagine if you could help people do this all over the world. You’d give them confidence and reassurance by protecting what they love most. It’s a big challenge, but you will be supported by a world-class team who believe in helping you to reach your full potential and deliver on our promises.

  

Diversity & Inclusion

At Zurich we are an equal opportunity employer.  We attract and retain the best qualified individuals available, without regard to race/ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age or disability.

So be challenged. Be inspired. Help us make a difference.

You are the heart & soul of Zurich!

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We highly value the experience and know-how of our employees and offer a wide range of opportunities across business areas to encourage you to apply for new opportunities within Zurich when you are ready for your next career step.

Let’s continue to grow together!
• Location(s): ES - Barcelona
• Remote working:
• Schedule: Full Time
• Recruiter name: Alvaro Gallego Zazo

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Project Manager

Location: Bristol (Hybrid)

This is a hybrid position primarily based in Bristol. We're committed to your flexibility and wellbeing and our hybrid strategy currently requires two days a week in the office, giving you the option to work remotely for some of your working week. Find out more about our culture of flexible working.

We give you a world of potential

Computershare Plan Managers (CPM) is the division within Computershare responsible for providing administrative services, project management and plan design to Plan Manager clients and their individual employee share plan holders. Plans Implementation is the team within CPM that Implements share plans for new or existing clients.

The Project Manager role operates within this team at a regional level to deliver projects that implement new share plans within agreed timeframes and quality standards in accordance with client expectations, project management process and regulatory guidelines.

The... Project Manager is expected to work collaboratively with external clients and across teams within the same region, supporting continuous improvement activity related to the role.

The Project Manager is responsible for the delivery to the defined scope, and quality of share plan implementation projects with medium complexity (as per the Computershare Project Complexity Assessment Model) for clients of Computershare Plan Managers. Projects involve external clients as well as multiple internal teams within Computershare.

The Project Manager works closely with relevant internal stakeholders to ensure all project activity is actioned in order to meet deadlines and deliver the anticipated benefits to the business and client satisfaction.

In addition the role holder will also manage client expectations, negotiate for internal resource and provide appropriate level of reporting and documentation for governance, quality and regulatory requirements.

A role you will love
• Deliver multiple client facing projects with a medium level of complexity to the agreed scope, quality, timeline and budget to the satisfaction of all stakeholders
• Create detailed plans for the project and implement monitoring, control and reporting processes using Key Decision Points to ensure that the project realises the benefits.
• Manage quality and detail of stakeholder requirements to build customer confidence, create long-lasting relationships and meet customers' needs.
• Influence and manage expectations of senior project stakeholders; both internal and external. Independently discuss service offering for at least two of our plan types and supporting services. Deliver clear and timely communications.
• Create the project governance, organisational structure and outline clear roles and responsibilities for all workstreams and sub-projects.
• Work closely with the Project Management Office (PMO) to ensure alignment of priorities, optimum resource usage and effective communication.
• Manage, lead, direct and motivate a medium project team.
• Ensure business readiness for supporting and ongoing administration of new share plans, products and services following project delivery; ensure formal closure of projects with review/lessons learned meetings with internal and external stakeholders.

What will you bring to the role?
• Proven experience of managing, leading and delivering projects with medium complexity
• Proven track record of delivering projects into an Operational environment with the financial services industry.
• Proven capability and expertise in Project delivery competencies: Delivery planning, risk and issue management, quality management, project reviews, change control, benefits and knowledge management.
• Project Managers will have 1-2 years' experience of managing projects in a related or similar environment.
• Particularly Microsoft Office (Word, Visio, Excel, PowerPoint) and MS Project with the ability to produce high quality written documentation, including reports, presentations slides & project plans.
• Able to analyse complex requirements, balance the needs of both internal and external customers, manage risks and issues, and prioritise based on benefits.
• Understand both the process for onboarding of new share plans and our service offering.
• Manage the onboarding of one or more plans for a client for projects with medium complexity.
• Can independently discuss and present the CPM Onboarding process.
• Manage medium project teams consisting of internal and external staff to help them deliver the project objectives. Contribute to the project management team by sharing experiences, helping other team members with issues and contributing to knowledge management and continuous improvement activities.
• Competent people skills - able to motivate team members to deliver in challenging situations.
• Create and present a vision and set direction, that motivates others to work towards a common goal.
• Influence decisions with both internal and external stakeholders
• Establish and develop productive relationships with internal and external stakeholders, bringing people together to benefit the project.
• Own decisions and be accountable for decisions made and the output from the project.
• Ensure the project team is working to full capacity, making best use of available resource.
• Give feedback on project team performance, individual and as a whole.
• Recognise and anticipate existing or potential conflicts at an individual or team level.
• Recognise problems and respond, systematically gather information, sort through complex issues, seek input from others, address root cause of issues, makes timely decisions, and communicates to others.
• Able to work in an environment of uncertainty and continual change. Able to feel comfortable making decisions and setting direction without having the full picture and re-focus as details emerge. Can apply knowledge and techniques to reduce ambiguity. Be open to new ideas and adjust plans to meet changing needs.
• Manage and lead a network of senior stakeholders both internal and external.
• Confident in dealing with external stakeholders e.g., executive level contacts at our clients and/or their vendors.
• Challenge senior stakeholders to ensure solutions are beneficial to the project/ company.
• able to build relationships and deal with challenging situations.
• Able to articulate information clearly and concisely via meetings, presentations, and workshops.
• Confident in dealing with senior management and executives across all areas of the business.
• Can tailor communications to suit different levels of audiences.
• Can present insights from data in engaging and impactful ways.

Computershare celebrate the diversity of our people, and we welcome applications from everyone. We believe that having a culture of inclusion is essential in delivering good results. jobs_results.description:
SUMMARY OF JOB:

The modular Data Centers have been driving a tremendous growth to the segment during the last years. As part of Data Center Systems Line of Business, The PREFABRICATED DATA CENTER organization design and integrates full solutions in the field of power conversion, energy storage, cooling, electrical distribution, and control software into modular enclosures.

, test the systems in the factory and deliver the final solution to the country of destination.

The Project Managers in our team take have the responsibility to successfully deliver these projects after the PO and lead the teams through the main project phases, such as design, procurement, production, testing, commissioning, and Services enablement. Having in charge the animation and the success of the project team in term of cost, quality, lead-time and business performance, the project managers ensure the delivery of the solution to the country of destination and secure a safe hand-over to the... customer.

Therefore, the Project Manager shall:
• Lead global, cross-functional teams to deliver Modular Data Centers for country based and global customers worldwide.
• Ensure at any time of the project an optimum customer satisfaction by applying SE Quality standards: in term of project execution and product development
• Optimize the business performance of the project, with a clear focus on the Gross Margin improvement all along the project cycle
• Communicate and coordinate communications among key stake holders in the project, including customer, Schneider entities and factories
• Motivate and direct teams to execute project plans and follow Schneider Electric CPP (Customer Project Processes) which is based on the PMI methodology.
• Closely control the project budget within the targeted margin objective and/or other project targets defined

ESSENTIAL RESPONSABILITIES
• Follow Company Customer Project Processes (CPP)
• Lead a global, multi-functional team to deliver project and offers to market
• Execute and implement all work aligned with the CPP
• Ensure the project governance is met according to the CPP and within SE tools and systems
• Deliver
• Manage projects focusing on the delivery of a product from concept to launch
• Manage project teams in a global matrix organization, across multiple time zones and locations
• Identify root causes of problems, offer options and solutions to resolve issues and own the resolution of any impediment
• Handle multiple projects simultaneously
• Work with functional management to staff projects appropriately
• Lead
• Work with internal and external factories that will integrate our solutions, and with all functions involved in the solution across Schneider-Electric

. Build trust and consensus for effective project collaboration
• Work Independently with little supervision. Show ownership of the project in any of its aspects.
• Advance corporate competencies and processes through continuous improvement activities
• Exercise Project Discipline
• Define the Project Management Plan at the beginning of each project to provide clarity towards all internal and external stakeholders

. Create and own project plans (schedule, resources) to meet project expectations and to ensure cost, quality, lead-time, and business performance.
• Coordinate all support activities to meet new product contract deliverables
• Analyze, anticipate, quantify, and mitigate risks (technical, schedule, manufacturability, application, etc.)
• Maintain a risk register to co-ordinate, record and manage potential issues and follow mitigation plans through to completion.
• Report
• Report status of project activity to all stakeholders (e.g., management, support functions, customers, etc.)
• Communicate and manage changes in project scope to departmental and cross functional teams
• Be responsible for project metrics for schedule, cost, quality, customer satisfaction
• Improve
• Interface with Cross-functional teams and with corporate project office to continuously improve the new product development processes
• Contribute towards performance reviews in partnership with functional managers

SCOPE AND SIZE

No direct report

EDUCATION
• Master’s degree in a Technical or Industrial field // Major in Electrical Engineering preferred
• PMP Certification desired

SKILLS
• Excellent communication, interpersonal and leadership
• English full professional competency
• Ability to work in a multicultural environment and different time zone

EXPERIENCE
• 5 – 7 Years’ experience as Project Manager
• 2 Years working on the Data Center segment preferred

TRAVEL
• Domestic and international travel, periodically <15%

OTHER KEY CONSIDERATIONS
• Located in Sant Boi, Barcelona, Spain

. Home office (3/5)

Why us?

At Schneider Electric we're committed to creating a workplace that gives you not just a job but a meaningful purpose in joining our mission to bring energy and efficiency to enable life, progress and sustainability for all.

We believe in empowering our team members to reach their full potential, fostering a sense of ownership in their work.

We embrace inclusion as a fundamental value, ensuring that every voice is heard and valued. We value differences, and welcome people from all walks of life. We believe in equal opportunities for everyone, everywhere.

If you want to be part of a company where your contributions truly matter, where you are empowered to make a difference and where inclusivity is valued, we would love to hear from you.

Discover your Meaningful, Inclusive and Empowered career at Schneider Electric.

€34.2bn global revenue
+12% organic growth
135 000+ employees in 100+ countries
#1 on the Global 100 World’s most sustainable corporations

You must submit an online application to be considered for any position with us. This position will be posted until filled

We mirror the diversity of the communities in which we operate and we ‘embrace different’ as one of our core values. jobs_results.title: SAP Senior Project Manager and Migration Specialist
jobs_results.description:
As project manager you will manage and lead SAP related projects with different levels of complexity. Taking part in our major S4/HANA initiative. You will build and evaluate the project regarding time, budget, quality, and customer satisfaction. You will hand over the project results into daily business. You have profound experience communicating complex concepts to your team and partners on different levels.

You Will
• Leads the operating entities (OEs) and delivery teams throughout the implementation project cycle including planning, execution, testing, migration, and cutover of SAP GRP projects and roll outs in Allianz.
• Develop project scope, including timeline and financials and ensuring technical feasibility.
• Partners with various functional and technical teams within Allianz Technology such as Ariba, IMA, ABAP, Basis, SAP Authorization.
• Partners with Financial Transformation team in ensuring the target design aligns with the implementation standards and group reporting... requirements.
• Lead from front on workshops and interviews to analyze business process and reporting requirements of the OEs.
• Work together with the business, delivery, and financial transformation teams to design the target state SAP solutions for the OE. Influence OEs thinking in adopting leading/ standard practices while developing target state.
• Understand SAP configuration and perform tests. Develop specifications for development of custom forms/ reports/ interfaces for the OE.
• Project Governance – monitors and controls project scope, schedule, budget, risk, and issues.
• Risk Management – identifying potential risks and developing strategies to mitigate them. Regularly monitoring risks and implementing contingency plans when required.
• Stakeholder Communication – maintaining effective communication with all project stakeholders, including business users, IT teams and executives.
• Issue Resolution – addressing and resolving project issues that may arise during the implementation, ensuring minimal impact on project objectives.
• Support change management execution by developing training material, delivering training, and supporting users post cutover.
• Manage all change requests, validate all budget/schedule impacts, obtain the stakeholder’s commitment, and communicate approved changes to all teams.
• Reporting – providing regular status updates to project stakeholders and senior management.
• Finish projects with proper documentation and handover of project results.
• Oversee the financial data migration process, ensuring data integrity and optimizing performance during the transition from legacy systems to S4 HANA platform of Allianz.
• Facilitate identification of financial data migration objects.
• Define, align, and maintain the migration plan per OE and track the execution.
• Provide best practices and toolkit for data migration (e.g. SAP Migration Cockpit, LSMW)
• Provisioning/creation of test data for FIT, UAT and other tests as part of trial migrations.
• Coordinate and monitor trial migrations according to the aligned data migration strategy and concept.
• Coordinate and safeguard final migration to Production.

Your Skills
• Completed a degree in business administration, economics, business informatics, mathematics, or similar.
• Several years of professional experience in project management in the SAP area with proven expertise in S4/HANA.
• Good knowledge of SAP migration methodologies
• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Actuarial or a related field
• Experience in at least one SAP full life cycle implementations

Skills, Knowledge & Competencies
• Hands on experience in SAP project management
• Excellent written and verbal communication skill in English
• Capability to work well under pressure, under cost and time constraints.
• Ability to excel in a global team environment, effectively communicate and achieve results.
• Reliable, independent, and result-oriented way of working
• Quick comprehension, creativity, and organizational skills
• Excellent teamwork and integration skills in a group-wide environment

Others
• Travel ability < 20%

Your benefits:
• We offer a hybrid work model which recognizes the value of striking a balance between in-person collaboration and remote working incl. up to 25 days per year working from abroad
• We believe in rewarding performance and our compensation and benefits package includes a company bonus scheme, pension, employee shares program and multiple employee discounts (details vary by location)
• From career development and digital learning programs to international career mobility, we offer lifelong learning for our employees worldwide and an environment where innovation, delivery and empowerment are fostered
• Flexible working, health and wellbeing offers (including healthcare and parental leave benefits) support to balance family and career and help our people return from career breaks with experience that nothing else can teach

As project manager you will manage and lead SAP related projects with different levels of complexity. Taking part in our major S4/HANA initiative. You will build and evaluate the project regarding time, budget, quality, and customer satisfaction. You will hand over the project results into daily business. You have profound experience communicating complex concepts to your team and partners on different levels.

You Will
• Leads the operating entities (OEs) and delivery teams throughout the implementation project cycle including planning, execution, testing, migration, and cutover of SAP GRP projects and roll outs in Allianz.
• Develop project scope, including timeline and financials and ensuring technical feasibility.
• Partners with various functional and technical teams within Allianz Technology such as Ariba, IMA, ABAP, Basis, SAP Authorization.
• Partners with Financial Transformation team in ensuring the target design aligns with the implementation standards and group reporting... requirements.
• Lead from front on workshops and interviews to analyze business process and reporting requirements of the OEs.
• Work together with the business, delivery, and financial transformation teams to design the target state SAP solutions for the OE. Influence OEs thinking in adopting leading/ standard practices while developing target state.
• Understand SAP configuration and perform tests. Develop specifications for development of custom forms/ reports/ interfaces for the OE.
• Project Governance – monitors and controls project scope, schedule, budget, risk, and issues.
• Risk Management – identifying potential risks and developing strategies to mitigate them. Regularly monitoring risks and implementing contingency plans when required.
• Stakeholder Communication – maintaining effective communication with all project stakeholders, including business users, IT teams and executives.
• Issue Resolution – addressing and resolving project issues that may arise during the implementation, ensuring minimal impact on project objectives.
• Support change management execution by developing training material, delivering training, and supporting users post cutover.
• Manage all change requests, validate all budget/schedule impacts, obtain the stakeholder’s commitment, and communicate approved changes to all teams.
• Reporting – providing regular status updates to project stakeholders and senior management.
• Finish projects with proper documentation and handover of project results.
• Oversee the financial data migration process, ensuring data integrity and optimizing performance during the transition from legacy systems to S4 HANA platform of Allianz.
• Facilitate identification of financial data migration objects.
• Define, align, and maintain the migration plan per OE and track the execution.
• Provide best practices and toolkit for data migration (e.g. SAP Migration Cockpit, LSMW)
• Provisioning/creation of test data for FIT, UAT and other tests as part of trial migrations.
• Coordinate and monitor trial migrations according to the aligned data migration strategy and concept.
• Coordinate and safeguard final migration to Production.

Your Skills
• Completed a degree in business administration, economics, business informatics, mathematics, or similar.
• Several years of professional experience in project management in the SAP area with proven expertise in S4/HANA.
• Good knowledge of SAP migration methodologies
• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Actuarial or a related field
• Experience in at least one SAP full life cycle implementations

Skills, Knowledge & Competencies
• Hands on experience in SAP project management
• Excellent written and verbal communication skill in English
• Capability to work well under pressure, under cost and time constraints.
• Ability to excel in a global team environment, effectively communicate and achieve results.
• Reliable, independent, and result-oriented way of working
• Quick comprehension, creativity, and organizational skills
• Excellent teamwork and integration skills in a group-wide environment

Others
• Travel ability < 20%

Your benefits:
• We offer a hybrid work model which recognizes the value of striking a balance between in-person collaboration and remote working incl. up to 25 days per year working from abroad
• We believe in rewarding performance and our compensation and benefits package includes a company bonus scheme, pension, employee shares program and multiple employee discounts (details vary by location)
• From career development and digital learning programs to international career mobility, we offer lifelong learning for our employees worldwide and an environment where innovation, delivery and empowerment are fostered
• Flexible working, health and wellbeing offers (including healthcare and parental leave benefits) support to balance family and career and help our people return from career breaks with experience that nothing else can teach

About Allianz Technology

Allianz Technology is the global IT service provider for Allianz and delivers IT solutions that drive the digitalization of the Group. With more than 13,000 employees located in 22 countries around the globe, Allianz Technology works together with other Allianz entities in pioneering the digitalization of the financial services industry.

We oversee the full digitalization spectrum – from one of the industry’s largest IT infrastructure projects that includes data centers, networking and security, to application platforms that span from workplace services to digital interaction. In short, we deliver full-scale, end-to-end IT solutions for Allianz in the digital age.

D&I statement

Allianz Technology is proud to be an equal opportunity employer encouraging diversity in the working environment. We are interested in your strengths and experience. We welcome all applications from all people regardless of gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, race or ethnicity, age, nationality, religion, disability, or philosophy of life.

jobs_results.title: Business Innovation Project Manager SWR
jobs_results.description:
Job Purpose

We are looking for an Business Innovation Project Manager for Bridgestone. This position is located in our Madrid office.

The main responsibilities are:
• Project Management Office, for successful project delivery and synergies optimization
• New Business model innovation, scouting opportunities for value creation
• Driving Mobility agenda, aligning BS entities common vision

Key Responsibilities

Project Management Office, ensuring timely execution in order to support growth objectives [40%]
• Strategic formulation
• Business cases development based on ROIC
• Internal buy-in process coordination
• Support functions alignment (Finance / Legal / Marketing / M&A…)
• Project Management & Product owner
• Roll out plans coordination with operations teams (BMS / Wholesale / Retail)
• Follow-up progress of milestones/goals through regular reviews & reporting
• Partnership management with third entities

Business Models innovation [25%]
• Encouraging to operational departments... for business expansion
• Analyzing data and trends to improve business performance
• Evaluate and implement new concepts and technologies to accelerate business development
• Business model definition (ideation)
• Synergies identification within other BS entities

Business Moldel Incubation [25%]
• Scouting opportunities with start-ups to enrich the group value proposition
• Identify and exploit partnership and growth opportunities for businesses
• Structuring potential partnerships for growth
• Facilitate and manage communication between entrepreneurs and their business partners
• Supporting the training and education of entrepreneurs

Collaborate with other BS entities to drive Mobility agenda [10%]
• Market intelligence: Understanding of mobility market trends, technology state of the art and fleet current / future expectations
• Facilitate SW strategy deployment within the mobility ecosystem (Connected, Shared, Electric, …)
• Participating in internal workgroups within EMIA organization and establishing direct connections with key EMIA stakeholders
• Best practices sharing: internal and external
• Participating in industry forums and Mobility associations
• Identifying business opportunities with local New Mobility Players (new eOEM)

Required Capabilities
• Bachelor's degree, and specialisation in Project Management. Knowledge in mobility, innovation can be considered as a plus.
• At least 5 years of experience in Project Management and demonstrable participation in innovation projects. Work experience in companies related to mobility is valued
• Spanish and English fluent (Group language) and Portuguese / French can be considered as a plus
• Willingness to travel
• Proficient Office 365 user
• Required Softskills:
• Strong values in line with Bridgestone’s behavioral expectations and embracing the Bridgestone Essence Philosophy
• High communication skills
• Agility – ability to work in a matrix and complex environment where change happens at a rapid pace
• Courage – ability to share ideas, make proposals for change
• Analytical skills, precise, rigorous and familiarity with numbers
• Strong ability to meet deadlines - reliable
• Ability to work within international environment different cultures
